This tutorial shows how to install The Crew Kodi Addon on Firestick, Android TV, Google TV, and any device.

We include a video tutorial as well as step-by-step screenshots to walk you through the entire installation process that only takes a few minutes.

The Crew has long been considered one of the top-ranked Kodi add-ons available today. This is an all-in-one add-on that features movies, TV shows, live channels, sports, adult content, and much more.

Those who have used Kodi have probably heard of The Crew by now. It has been around for several years and is found within many popular Kodi builds.

The team behind The Crew is continually updating it with new features and improvements as well as a Beta Program! (More info on this below).

The latest release is V3.2.9 with enhanced updates which you can find in the full Changelog as pictured below.

How to Install The Crew Kodi Addon

  • Launch the Kodi App, then click Settings. 

  • Select the System icon.

  • If it isn’t already enabled, click the toggle to turn on Unknown sources.

  • Click Yes. (Make sure to use a VPN to protect your privacy)

  • Return to the System menu and open File manager.

Addon Integrations

To have the best streaming experience with The Crew, we suggest integrating premium services like TorBox, Premiumize, Trakt, and more.

Also, to ensure you are always running the most recent version of The Crew or any other add-on, we suggest turning “Auto-Update” ON.

Premium Debrid Services

Pairing a premium debrid service such as Real-Debrid, Premiumize, TorBox, AllDebrid, etc. will bring the highest quality streaming links and ensure The Crew runs at peak performance. In the example below we are integrating TorBox.

1. Launch the Crew and choose Settings.

2. Select ResolveURL: Settings.

3. Find your preferred Debrid Service and click authorize.

4. You will then recieve an activation code.

5. Visit the authorization website and input your provided code.

6. Return back to The Crew and you will see an authorization success message.

7. After selecting a movie or TV show you should now be seeing ‘paid’ streaming links.

Enjoy!

Trakt TV

If you are a user of Trakt.tv, The Crew is a great place to integrate your account. This popular service helps users sync and scrobble all their media content across numerous devices and platforms.

1. You will first need to create a free Trakt account if you don’t already have one.

2. Launch The Crew Kodi add-on.

3. Scroll down and click Tools.

4. Click Trakt Authorize.

5. Write down or remember provided code

6. Go to trakt.tv/activate on any Browser

7. Enter the code from the previous step and click Continue.

8. Click Yes.

9. An authorization message will appear for Trakt.

10. Return back to The Crew Kodi add-on and you will find that your Trakt account has been successfully integrated.

The Crew Kodi Addon Categories & Details

The Crew is a premium Kodi add-on that has an easy-to-use interface and works very well. We breakdown the categories of this add-on and explain the best features for each below.

Movies

Within the Movies tab are various options including My Movies, Trending, Genres, Year, People, Trakt Lists, and more.

TV Shows

The TV Shows tab also provides similar categories such as Trending, Genres, Most Voted, International, Most Popular, and more.

Sports

Many stream Sports and replays within the Sports tab.

Kids

One of the best features of the Crew is that it is perfect for families with a Dedicated Kids section! There are options for Debrid Kids, Action Hero, Learning TV, Kids Songs, and more.

1-Clicks

For those who prefer auto-play, The Crew provides a One-Click category for instant streaming of Movies and TV Shows.

CC Collections

CC Collections is a unique category that offers other on-demand content.

Settings

Within the Settings category you can integrate debrid services and access settings.

Search

The search category allows you to easily find any content available within The Crew add-on.

Adult Content

Unlike other popular VOD add-ons, The Crew also features a hidden category for watching adult content. Here is how you can access this “secret” category.

1. From the home screen, open the Tools menu.

2. Select SETTINGS: Navigation.

3. Click Adult Play Ground.

4. Enter lol for the password and click OK.

5. Click OK again.

Restart your Kodi device and you can now find adult options within The Crew. Enjoy!

Settings

The Crew provides tons of Tools that users can personalize for a fabulous viewing experience.

Those of you who prefer subtitles can easily enable this feature within the Tools Category.

There are also various settings such as Providers, Playback, Viewtypes, and more, that give the end-user full power of this addon.

Enabling/Disabling various Providers is a great way to adjust the scrapers for links displayed.

You can also adjust the Torrent Providers which but if you have these enabled make sure you are using a VPN!

Make sure to file through all Settings options to adjust them to your liking and make The Crew work for you.
